record.provider: Perplexity Projects (formerly Spaces) — persistent file repository

free_tier.stated: 5 GB per Project, 10,000 files per Project, 100 MB per file. Identical on every plan, including free. Projects themselves: 'There's no limit on how many Projects you can create.'.

retention.stated: Session uploads (not Projects) are 40-50 MB/file and are deleted after 7 days. Do not confuse the two.

egress.terms: No egress concept. Files are read by the model or viewed in-app, not served over a shareable URL.

record.interface_detail: Web UI only for consumer. No public Files API. Enterprise has File Connectors and an organization repository (being retired 2026-10-01).
record.tooling: None for storage. Unofficial browser automation only.
record.chaining: Unlimited Projects x 5 GB each. Projects are the multiplicative axis and the help centre states the cap is absent. Unlike NotebookLM, adding a Project costs nothing and there is no account-wide byte wall documented.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 100 MB. Session uploads (not Projects) are 40-50 MB/file and are deleted after 7 days. Do not confuse the two. Projects created before Aug 2026 may exceed 5 GB and then refuse new uploads.
record.reliability_note: Projects retain uploaded files until deleted. No public API is provided and programmatic interaction requires browser automation. Access is restricted to internal search readers, and unsupported binary formats cannot be exported or queried via documented endpoints.

evidence.proved: 'Every Project supports up to 10,000 files, 5 GB of total storage, and 100 MB per file. These limits are the same for all subscribers, regardless of plan'; table 'Total storage per Project | 5 GB'
'There's no limit on how many Projects you can create.'
'Files uploaded to sessions are retained for 7 days, then deleted'; organization file repository 'retired on October 1, 2026'

record.notes: 5 GB per Project, 10,000 files per Project, 100 MB per file. Identical on every plan, including free. Projects themselves: 'There's no limit on how many Projects you can create.'.
